scope: WevaView live reload of its HTML/CSS files while running (addon GDScript only; no native change).
findings: A stylesheet edit reapplies the CSS and keeps the document, state and bindings; a markup edit reloads the HTML with bound data re-applied; later data changes still reach the reloaded markup.
A file is read only after its modified time has stayed put for one poll interval, so half-written saves are skipped.
live_reload=false ignores disk changes; the default is OS.is_debug_build().
limitations: Polls modified times (one-second resolution); exported PCK files report no time and never reload.
Not yet in any packaged addon zip; the preview219 zip predates this script.
